hero.description: JVM Solutions builds high-performance digital products — from pixel-perfect frontends to intelligent backends, cross-platform mobile apps, and AI-powered automation that transforms workflows.

services.subtitle: Whatever your challenge — we have the expertise to engineer the right solution.

frontend.title: Frontend Development

backend.title: Backend Systems
backend.description: Scalable APIs, microservices and cloud infrastructure built primarily on .NET. From REST to gRPC, designed for reliability, security and high throughput.

mobile.title: Mobile Applications
mobile.description: Native iOS and Android apps built with Swift and Kotlin. Full-native performance, platform-specific UX, and direct access to every device API.

ai.title: AI Automation
ai.description: LLM integrations, intelligent agents, and workflow automation that reduce manual effort and unlock new capabilities for your business.

portfolio.subtitle: A snapshot of what we've built — each one a partnership, a challenge, and a solution delivered.

logistics.title: TrackMate — Logistics Mobile

ai.title: FlowBot — AI Workflow Engine
